carrier_consequence.first_factor: Y is the normalization of N x_{z,X4} C0.
carrier_consequence.function_field_consequence: If K(C0)=K(X4)(sqrt(F)), then K(N)(sqrt(F(z))) = K(Y) = K(N)(sqrt(F(w))).
carrier_consequence.hypothesis: N is the normalization of a hypothetical integral carrier mapping to B, and Y is the normalization of its Beauville pullback N x_B X.
carrier_consequence.meaning: The Pic/2 class is not an independent unknown for an actual carrier; zero is forced conditionally by the global subgroup-quotient geometry.
carrier_consequence.second_factor: Y is the normalization of N x_{w,X4} C0.
carrier_consequence.squareclass_consequence: F(w)/F(z) is a square in K(N)^*.

group_quotient_square.B: P/G_diag (box surface on the retained open/normalization level)
group_quotient_square.P: Z x Z with diagonal G action
group_quotient_square.generic_fiber_argument: Given a generic G_diag-orbit [(x,y)] and an H-orbit of the chosen factor above its G-orbit, the unique coset in G/H selecting that H-orbit also selects a unique H_diag-orbit in P. Hence X is generically the degree-two pullback of C0 over X4.
group_quotient_square.normalization_statement: X is the normalization of B x_{X4} C0 for either factor; both finite covers have the same generic degree two extension.

relation_to_previous_pic2_reduction.do_not_use_for_exclusion: The forced zero class is a compatibility identity already built into a genuine map N->B; it does not prove such N exists and cannot by itself exclude O=210.
